summary: E2B's free Hobby tier gives new users a one-time $100 in usage credits. Official limits include up to 1-hour continuous sandbox runtime, 20 concurrently running sandboxes, 10 GiB disk, 8 vCPUs, and 8 GiB memory. Compute is billed per second against the credits.
claim_steps: Open E2B pricing and choose Start for Free under Hobby.
Create an E2B account to receive the one-time $100 usage credits.
Use the credits for per-second sandbox compute within Hobby-tier limits.
